anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Witte p.132 / PDF 136. Book II marked β. Insertion πρὸς <σ>ωτηρίαν.

bible_refs.note: Wrath on Egypt; firstborn of Israel saved.

choices.why: The old rite was already a mystery, not a bare history.

pass_a_gloss: The sacred-service and sacred-sacrifice having been completed mysteriously according to God who commanded toward salvation of the firstborn of the sons of Israel, because of the wrath being brought upon Pharaoh and those according to his rule disobeying God's word, having been completed in the former time of Moses,
pass_b_english: The sacred service and the sacred sacrifice having been completed in the former time of Moses, in a mystery, according to God who commanded it, for the salvation of the firstborn of the sons of Israel — because the wrath was being brought upon Pharaoh and those under his rule who disobey the word of God —
source_text: Τῆς ἱερουργίας καὶ ἱεροθυσίας μυστηριωδῶς κατὰ τὸν προστάξαντα θ(εὸ)ν πρὸς <σ>ωτηρίαν τῶν πρωτοτόκων τῶν υἱῶν Ἰ(σρα)ὴλ διὰ τὸ τὴν ὀργὴν ἐπιφέρεσθαι Φαραώ τε καὶ τοῖς κατὰ τὴν αὐτοῦ ἀρχὴν ἀπειθοῦσιν λόγῳ θ(εο)ῦ τετελεσμένης ἐν τῷ πρόσθεν χρόνῳ Μωϋσέως,
